preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0]) - 1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for u, v in edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0]) - 1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output) <= n - 1 for n, output in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum number of vertices Misha can save, which is between 0 and n-1.
